rv.q: "The Family Album" blends those two ideas in a creative, emotionally resonant, and frequently funny world premiere musical that tackles the raw, transformative journey of healing intergenerational trauma .
The Family Album posee todos los elementos de un musical memorable: una historia emocionalmente resonante, personajes complejos, música poderosa y un mensaje universal.
As dark as this show may sound, the musical is filled with many humorous and heartwarming moments.

rv.o: To See or Not to See
rv.q: All of the actors nail their numbers, making the musical tight and polished.
The Family Album is the kind of new musical that feels destined for a Broadway future.

cn.t: Critics praise "The Family Album" as a heartfelt, emotionally resonant musical that explores family dynamics and self-acceptance through compelling indie-pop music and universal themes of healing and reconciliation.
